TITLE: International School Eindhoven - International School Eindhoven

International School Eindhoven
Welcome to the International School Eindhoven!
A caring and challenging learning environment that fosters international mindedness.
HELLO! Welcome to the International School Eindhoven (ISE), a non-profit Dutch International School. ISE is nestled at two locations in the heart of the Brainport region, one of the world’s leading innovation hubs for design, science, and technology. At the ISE, we proudly serve a diverse community of over 1400 students and 200 dedicated teachers, representing 60 unique nationalities and speaking more than 40 languages.
We are inclusive, authentic, and caring global citizens!
Global citizenship is understanding our place in the world and widening our horizons. This requires reflecting on who we are, and where we are in this world, and using our skills and knowledge to make wise decisions and respect differences.
We encourage our students to exceed the norms of academic intentions, challenge themselves and each other, and be thoughtful, creative, and innovative in the work they are doing. As an international school, we are incorporating the ideas and perspectives as well as the cultures and identities of our students and community.
Multicultural and language-friendly community!
We are an official language-friendly school and have a multicultural and multilingual community, where diversity is celebrated. Our international curriculum and extensive extracurricular activities help to foster mutual respect and understanding among our students and staff.
We are proud!
We are proud to be an accredited international school by the Council of International Schools (CIS)  and the International Baccalaureate (IB). This is our testimony to our commitment to continually improve and develop. Our approach, dedicated staff, and small class sizes ensure we cater to, support, and challenge our students.
Education is our passion!
At the ISE, we provide High-Quality Learning that is a creative educational path teaching students to be successful in situations based on real life. Throughout their studies at the ISE, the students have many opportunities to explore authentic world issues, learn how to develop an argument, voice their opinions, and get involved in the local, national and global communities.
Our curriculum is aimed to create independent learners, global mindsets and world citizens who continue to develop curiosity in learning so that they have the strategies to be able to become lifelong learners!
ISE offers Primary (International), Primary (Dutch Bilingual), and Secondary education in a caring and challenging environment. We support our students not only in their academic needs but also in their socio-emotional development. We make sure that every student has all the tools they need to develop their skills and broaden their knowledge. We aim to inspire our students to be independent, lifelong learners with a global mindset.
Thank you for your interest in the International School of Eindhoven.
